# Materia — full agent brief

Materia publishes 12 static public pages and 543 collection pages: 24 body parts, 77 conditions, 207 remedies, 60 compounds, 175 studies.

## Materia

Explore an evidence-graded, study-cited knowledge graph from body parts to conditions, remedies, compounds, and research.

Materia is an ad-free reference, not a diagnosis or treatment service. Use the body explorer or the public indexes to navigate the cited corpus.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/index.md

## About Materia

Why Materia connects interactive anatomy with evidence-graded remedies and primary research.

Materia aggregates public evidence so readers can inspect how a remedy, condition, compound, and study connect. It does not replace clinical care.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/about
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/about.md

## Interaction and safety checker

Check a local list of herbs, supplements, and drugs for recorded interactions, duplicate compounds, and shared risks.

The checker runs in the browser against Materia's cited interaction graph. It does not diagnose, prescribe, or guarantee that an unlisted combination is safe.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/checker
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/checker.md

## Compounds

Browse the active compounds behind Materia remedies and follow their mechanisms and biological targets.

Each compound page connects a named constituent to the remedies that contain it.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/compounds
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/compounds.md

## Conditions

Browse conditions, body-part relationships, red flags, and evidence-graded remedy claims.

Condition pages describe the cited evidence and surface red flags that should prompt professional care.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/conditions
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/conditions.md

## Data and knowledge-graph export

Download the public Materia knowledge graph as structured JSON.

The JSON export contains the same public collection nodes and typed relationships used by the website. It is a data resource, not medical advice.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/data
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/data.md

## Medical disclaimer

Understand the limits of Materia's educational, evidence-aggregation content.

Materia provides general educational information. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or a substitute for a qualified clinician.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/disclaimer
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/disclaimer.md

## Frequently asked questions

Answers about Materia's evidence grades, citations, safety posture, and data sources.

The FAQ explains how to interpret the reference and what Materia deliberately does not claim.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/faq
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/faq.md

## Evidence methodology

How Materia assigns evidence grades per remedy and condition and links every efficacy claim to citations.

Grades apply to one remedy-condition claim at a time. Efficacy and safety are separate, and every efficacy claim must cite at least one study or source.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/methodology
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/methodology.md

## Body parts

Browse anatomical entry points into Materia's condition and remedy graph.

Body-part pages connect anatomy to related conditions and onward to cited remedy evidence.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/parts
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/parts.md

## Remedies

Browse herbs, supplements, nutrients, chemicals, practices, medicines, and drugs in the Materia corpus.

A remedy page separates evidence by condition, preserves negative findings, and lists recorded safety information.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/remedies
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/remedies.md

## Search Materia

Search public conditions, remedies, body parts, and compounds.

Search is a public navigation tool over the checked-in corpus. Agents can also follow the collection templates in the agent catalog.

- HTML: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/search
- Markdown: https://materia.significanthobbies.com/search.md

## Content and safety boundary

The checked-in Astro content collections are the source for the public HTML, Markdown, and knowledge-graph export. Materia does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace clinical care. Every efficacy claim must carry at least one citation, and grades apply per remedy-condition pair rather than globally.
